blocks.text: Fans known as “Kamag-anak,” supporters of the vlogging family “Ong Fam,” gathered outside the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Central Office along East Avenue in Quezon City on Monday, November 23, hoping to catch a glimpse of their idol, Geo Ong.
